notes: Small grass forms: mounds, verges, tufts. gradientBase/gradientHeight are OBJECT space and this geometry is unit-sized: metre-scale values here saturate the sweep to a constant and switch the vertical gradient off entirely, which is how every instanced asset in the greybox lost it. Saturation corrected: lit must sit BELOW shadow in chroma (measured -0.15 across references); the earlier ART_BIBLE rule had this inverted. Brush overlay reduced 1.45 -> 0.0: the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1) and this was still running at full strength, which is the camouflage mottle on terrain.
